environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; large, heavy scales with a slight iridescent sheen; thick, paddle-like fins; small but bright eyes; the fish looks robust and ancient.

visual_logic.composition: A side-profile view of the lungfish resting at the bottom of a shallow, murky pool. The water is clear enough to see its 'armored' scales. In the background, the thick, purple-red clay of the Anacleto forms a steep bank, with a few ancient horsetails reflected in the water's surface.
visual_logic.ground: A bed of soft, fine river silt and decaying organic matter (leaves/twigs) over a base of red-purple clay.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft, diffused morning light filtering through a light mist, giving the water a cool, emerald-green tint.
